subject: NorthArch RFI: request for control validation pack and artifact delivery plan
messages:
-----Message 1-----
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northarch.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: Bob Lopez <bob.lopez@northarch.com>, security@northarch.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NorthArch RFI: control-level validation pack request

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the SIG spreadsheet you sent last week. The procurement and security teams reviewed it and have two follow-ups before we can advance to vendor scoring:

1) Can you provide a control-level mapping from Redwood's implementation to the SIG control IDs (we need the traceability matrix for our audit team)?
2) For a sample of controls (crypto key management, privileged access, and logging retention), we need artifacts: config screenshots or export, a representative log bundle (obfuscated), and owner confirmations.

I've attached an updated worksheet with highlighted rows (northarch_SIG_v2.xlsx). For the log sample, please do not include PII — redacted or synthetic is fine. Also include an expected ETA for delivery and a point-of-contact for any legal redlines.

Best,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Analyst
NorthArch Financial

-----Message 2-----
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northarch.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthArch RFI: control-level validation pack request

Alice — thanks for the clear asks and the annotated sheet. We're on it. Quick plan:

- Priyom will own the control mapping (SIG -> Redwood control/implementation notes).
- Kimberly will coordinate artifact collection and redaction guidance for the log bundle.
- I'll be your escalation + timelines owner (and will coordinate legal if any contract language is needed).

Proposed ETA: preliminary mapping + delivery plan by Tue Apr 13 COB PST; artifacts (redacted logs + screenshots) by Thu Apr 15 EOD PST. If that works, we'll proceed and attach a short deliverable checklist.

Two clarifying q's:
1) For logs, do you prefer a zip with a README that states what was redacted, or a small set of filtered CSV exports?
2) Is evidence delivery via our secure transfer (link below) acceptable? (we can also upload to your SharePoint if you prefer)

Secure transfer link (internal): https://transfer.redwood.ai/secure/NorthArch-DEAL1983

—Sean
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

-----Message 3-----
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northarch.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG control mapping draft + questions about scope

Hi Alice — attaching our draft control cross-reference (I pasted the key sections into the file and will upload a formal XLSX if you want). High level notes:

- Crypto KMS: Redwood uses a customer-isolated KMS integration for Private deployments; hosted customers have an RBAC-segmented KMS abstraction. For SIG CC-17/CC-18 mapping we include config snippets and a short narrative describing key rotation cadence and split responsibilities.
- Privileged access: we mapped SIG controls to our IAM roles + PAM integration; I've flagged one control where we rely on cloud provider logs as supplemental evidence (marked in the sheet).
- Logging retention: default retention is 90 days for debug-level telemetry and 365 days for audit logs in Dedicated; we can provide an exported retention policy and a sample log bundle (redwood_sample_logs_2026q4.zip).

Questions:
1) On the KMS artifact — is a screenshot of the KMS policy console sufficient, or do you require a signed attestation from our cloud provider?
2) For the log bundle, we plan to include a README explaining redaction and sampling methodology. Please confirm whether NorthArch needs native syslog format or parsed CSV snippets.

I'll upload the draft mapping to the shared Drive and the XLSX once we consolidate internal notes. ETA for the XLSX: Wed Apr 14 noon PST.

Thanks,
Priyom
Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference

-----Message 4-----
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northarch.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: Bob Lopez <bob.lopez@northarch.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 07:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG control mapping draft + questions about scope

Thanks Priyom — the draft looks promising. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- KMS: a screenshot + export of the effective policy JSON is sufficient for now. If the control is critical for our internal audit we may request a provider attestation later, but start with the policy export.
- Logs: native syslog format preferred for the audit team; CSV snippets are okay for triage but please include at least one syslog file showing rotation headers and retention markers.
- Legal: procurement (Bob) asked for a short statement on data residency for any sample you provide; please include the region the sample came from and confirm no live customer PII is present.

If you can hit EOD today for the XLSX and a link to the sample bundle, we'll queue this for the internal scoring committee next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Alice

-----Message 5-----
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northarch.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Bob Lopez <bob.lopez@northarch.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NorthArch RFI: request for control validation pack and artifact delivery plan

Alice — thanks for the clarifications. Deliverables attached and links below:

Deliverables included (zip + spreadsheet):
- redwood_northarch_control_mapping_20270415.xlsx (spreadsheet mapping SIG IDs to Redwood controls and implementation notes)
- redwood_sample_logs_2026q4.zip (syslog sample + README with redaction steps and region: us-west-2)
- kms_policy_export.json (exported effective policy snapshot)
- evidence_checklist.txt (short owner confirmations and artifact provenance)

Transfer link: https://transfer.redwood.ai/secure/NorthArch-DEAL1983 (expires 2027-04-22)
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/NorthArch-RFI-2027

Notes:
- All samples were synthesized from production telemetry and redacted to remove any customer-identifiable fields. The README in the zip enumerates sample cadence and redaction logic.
- For the one control that references cloud-provider supplemental logs, we included a labelled export and a short statement from our Infrastructure team (owner: Aditya Rao) confirming the provenance.

If you need a provider-signed attestation for KMS after your scoring, Kim and I can route that through legal. Otherwise, let us know if the bundle hits the mark.

—Sean
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
